personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (with 8 Hand-Drawn/Journal color palette for everyday calmness, and 5 Brutalist high-visibility patterns for Emergency modes)
personality_one_liner: A calm, deeply reassuring everyday sanctuary that instantly transforms into a high-visibility, impossible-to-miss command center during an emergency.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native padding for everyday screens to evoke calm; tight, structured padding for emergency states to maximize touch targets.

do's: Use over map backgrounds in 'Find Help Nearby' for the bottom sheet header.
Use on the sticky bottom CTA container to keep content visible underneath.
dont's: Never use on the Emergency Mode full-screen override (must be high contrast solid red).
Do not use on forms or journal entries.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: A clear, uncluttered hub indicating safety status and providing a 1-tap emergency trigger.

states.empty: All good state with a calm botanical illustration.

screens.layout: Top section features a large, color-independent Status Indicator (Icon + Text: 'Safe', 'Check-in pending'). Center focus is an oversized 'I NEED HELP' button (swipe/slider style to prevent accidental touch, using high-visibility red). Lower half uses a 2-column grid (`flexWrap: 'wrap'`, `space-between`) for Quick Actions (Start Timer, Safe Journey, Share Location).

screens.name: Safety
screens.purpose: Manage active safety modes and track current location sharing.

states.empty: No active modes: calm illustration + 'Start a mode'.
states.error: Could not fetch modes, tap to retry.

screens.layout: iOS-native grouped list view for configuring 'Event Mode', 'Work Mode', etc. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom ('Start Mode') wrapped in a glass container over scrolling content.

screens.name: Find Help Nearby
screens.purpose: Offline-capable map and directory of shelters, medical, and psychological support.

states.empty: No resources found in radius. Adjust filters.

screens.layout: Map view occupies top 60%. A `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` occupies the lower section housing category filters (pills) and the curated directory list. Tapping a list item/pin opens a detail sheet with 1-tap call and walking ETA.

screens.name: Incident Journal
screens.purpose: Private, locked space to record incidents securely.

states.empty: Soft, calm journal illustration. 'Your private space to record incidents. Nobody else can see this.'

screens.layout: Editorial-style layout with generous `xl` spacing. Soft tinted background (`surface`). FAB in bottom right (`brandPrimary` pill with glass shadow) to log new entry. List of past entries uses `surfaceSecondary` cards with `md` radius.

screens.name: Emergency Mode (Full-Screen)
screens.purpose: Override the UI with an impossible-to-miss alert state under extreme stress.

states.error: Shows 'Failed to send' with manual SMS fallback.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background using `error` (Signal Red). Massive, bold typography ('NOTIFYING CONTACTS...'). Massive touch targets. A central slider to 'CALL EMERGENCY SERVICES' and a large, high-contrast button to 'CANCEL EMERGENCY'.

screens.name: Profile & Settings
screens.purpose: Manage trusted contacts, privacy settings, and access the AI Chatbot.
screens.layout: iOS-native grouped list rows. App Lock (Biometric/PIN) clearly visible at top. Education Section/Chatbot uses a featured hero card at the top with a subtle background image and top-to-bottom gradient scrim.

emergency_background.alt: High contrast red emergency alert background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color-independent status rule: Safe/Active/Check-in/Emergency must pair an Icon with Text, never rely on color alone.
Implement the 'I NEED HELP' emergency trigger as a slider, not a single tap button, to prevent accidental triggers (based on UX research for modern safety apps).
For the Emergency Mode override screen, discard the soft botanical palette and use the `error` signal red full-bleed. Text must be max contrast.
Ensure 'Find Help Nearby' uses `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` over the map and glassmorphism on the header of the sheet for iOS-native layered feel.
Text overlaid on images (e.g., Profile education hero) MUST have a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent -> 20% -> 70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG contrast.
Use Phosphor icons consistently across all tabs and settings rows. Do not mix weights.
Ensure sticky primary buttons (like 'Start Mode') are placed at the bottom, outside the scroll view, with a glass background to let content scroll behind securely.
